title: Prompt2Craft: Generating Functional Craft Assemblies With LLMs

live_model.evidence: Sec. IV-A: "The LLM used is OpenAI's o4-mini-2025-04-16, with reasoning effort set to 'high'...It was selected due to its strong reasoning performance and accepting multi-modal inputs."

prompt.location: Sec. III-C/D (template format and prompt description) and Appendix A (complete field/value listing); Fig. 2 overview
prompt.note: Re-prompting strategies (with/without feedback) described in Sec. III-I.

claim.metric: overall craft-generation success rate, no re-prompting (85.0% after allowing re-prompts)

data.source: 8 object categories (hammer, bookshelf, chair, table, bus, scooter, skateboard, truck), one scene, 41 part types; uses the public PartCrafter model for mesh generation

notes: Table I gives per-class percentages (e.g. Hammer 81%/95%, Shelves 53%/80%) but the number of trials underlying each percentage is not stated in the visible text, only the 8-class x 3-function x 41-part-type design, so n_items is left unclear.
